fusions.name: Sprung From Still Water
fusions.desc: A sudden strike from stillness that deals 18 damage and consumes every affliction on the target, adding 1.5 times their remaining damage to the hit. It has 50% more critical chance against a target that has not been hurt yet, and stuns it for 1.2 seconds.

fusions.name: Hatchling Spray
fusions.desc: Spits 3 hatchlings at once, spread apart out to 7 tiles, each dealing 4 damage and having a 25% chance to leave the target [Slowed] for 3 seconds.

fusions.name: Under the Pad
fusions.desc: Veils you for 8 seconds. Enemies notice you 60% later, you move 15% faster, and the veil breaks the moment you attack.

fusions.name: Played Dead
fusions.desc: Once your health falls below 30%, a shield worth 20% of your maximum health closes over you for 5 seconds. You gain +6% dodge chance. Once every 30 seconds.
